patch_description: Instead of a single randomized greedy pass, this approach runs many independent greedy constructions with different starting transactions (multi-restart diversification), then improves the best schedule with a first-improvement 2-opt swap local search. The greedy step uses exact makespan evaluation via `get_opt_seq_cost` of the partial sequence to pick the next transaction (least-increase greedy), which the original already did partially but only once with sampling noise. Adding beam-style restarts + local search escape local optima and reliably lower makespan.
